pipeline.method: eye-nose-chin geometry baseline; no pose-angle solver
pipeline.threshold_status: default down=.40 selected on Pointing04 validation; yaw=.18 experimental; overrides user-supplied; no test data used for default selection
pipeline.landmark_convention: full-image normalized x,y; x rightward,y downward

detector.face_order: frame-local detector order; no association or persistent identity

definitions.accuracy: correct / all eligible labeled images; unknown predictions are incorrect
definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean over all four fixed direction classes; zero-denominator F1 is zero
definitions.coverage: usable direction predictions / all eligible labeled images
definitions.conditional_accuracy: correct / usable direction predictions; supplementary only
definitions.confusion_matrix: rows: ground truth; columns: prediction, including unknown
definitions.unit: one annotated subject per image; multiple faces are ambiguous, not cherry-picked

timing.scope: Decode, preprocessing, inference, prediction and record construction; excludes initialization, checksum preflight and report writing; no explicit warmup excluded. This is not video FPS.
